title: DO NOT GIVE YOUR CARD DETAILS!!!
body:
Incredibly disappointed at how scam-like and misleading the sign up process is for this app! I agreed to the $18 four-week trial period, and I was charged not only that but another $98 as of immediately! I tired to exit the next page which pressures you incessantly to purchase more add-ons (before you even download the app!), of which when I managed to get out of it, another page appeared asking for even more money for another add-on. I saw that as a red flag and immediately shut down the page and checked my bank account but it was too late. They make it incredibly hard to cancel or get help as there is no number you can call, only an email address. I have had to cancel and replace my card which is super annoying. 
This company should be ashamed of their predatory-like sales techniques and it should be illegal. But with loose regulations unfortunately companies like this can continue to use certain tactics to scam unknowing and trusting people out of money. 
If they were honest and upfront and didn’t employ purposefully confusing and near impossible to navigate tactics of what you actually are consenting to, they would be far more reputable as a business. Always do your due diligence before you purchase an app or anything else, even if it comes across as legitimate!! - from someone who learnt the hard way. 
Not worth the stress of having money taken out of your account that you didn’t consent to, even if the app does work to some degree, unless you have tonnes of money to spare and money doesn’t matter to you, and if you don’t mind being taken advantage of.
author: AmyM1357

title: Will not un subscribe me
body:
I didn’t realise that I was subscribing to a $45 (us) a month app, it wasn’t clear at all. I emailed Ultiself and asked them to unsubscribe me on several occasions but they kept replying with the same generic email offering me more services that I don’t want. I’ve emailed more times but they will not reply to say they’ve unsubscribed me.
I’ve written posts on their facebook page to warn others but these comments keep getting deleted. I’ve now raised a dispute with my bank. I really would be very cautious about signing up to this app.
